title: Can I BEAT Martin with a Spinner Wheel?
summary: Tony plays Martin but must move whatever piece type a spinner wheel selects each turn (pawn, knight, bishop, rook, queen, king). If he cannot legally move that piece type (including when in check and the rolled piece can't resolve it), he loses immediately. Most games end on the first spin (only pawn/knight can move from the start). After ~60+ games he never wins; he concludes it is far harder than expected.
rules: Before each player move, spin a wheel of piece types: pawn, knight, bishop, rook, queen, king.
Player must move a piece of the rolled type.
If no legal move exists for the rolled type (e.g. bishop on move 1, or in check and the type can't block/capture/escape) the player loses the game.
win_condition: Checkmate Martin (not achieved in the video after ~60+ attempts).
